title: Zhentarim Shipping Crate
summary: Moonrise shipment with parasite specimens and a 20 ft Caustic Brine spill.

fields.Pickup: Picking up the crate adds two Mind Flayer Parasite Specimens. The source notes the pickup route depends on the character having consumed their first tadpole.
fields.Throw or destroy: Break it or use Throw to burst it and create a 20 ft radius Caustic Brine surface. It deals 1d4 Acid on entry and 1d4 Acid per turn while occupied, with no save. Fire or contact with a Burning creature or object converts it into a Fire surface with a harmless explosion. Dropped potions shatter on contact and leave their effects on the ground.
fields.Contents: Destroying the crate leaves three dead tadpoles. If it was not collected first, or its collector had never consumed a tadpole, it also leaves two specimens. Without contact with Fire a live tadpole can scurry away. Killing it gives 110 XP. The crate also contains three random grenades.
fields.Examine and acquire: At the Moonrise Towers docks (−70, −186). Examine with DC 16 Investigation or use the available familiar-seal dialogue branch.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
